output_list.reason: The 'reward' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is in the following code: 'require(totalLockedRewardsOf[_to] + _value > totalLockedRewardsOf[_to]);'. If 'totalLockedRewardsOf[_to]' is at its maximum value, adding _value will cause an overflow, allowing attackers to increase the balance of any user to any value.
